deck.name: Insight Engine Tarot — Full Deck V2

intake_method.delivery_form: 7 repackaged zip parts (not a raw byte-split of the original archive), each independently valid, delivered as chat uploads
intake_method.reason: The governed script hashes a single archive file against a locked EXPECTED_ARCHIVE_SHA256. Because these 7 parts are independently repackaged zips (each with its own container metadata), no recombination of them can reproduce the original archive's exact bytes, so the whole-archive hash gate cannot structurally run against this delivery form. The script was not modified to bypass this check.
manual_verification_performed: SHA-256 of each of the 7 uploaded parts matched the sender-supplied parts_manifest.json exactly
All 79 PNG filenames from parts_manifest.json entries matched 1:1 against the extracted files on disk (no missing, no extra, no duplicates)
Per-image Pillow load/verify + dimension check: 75 images at 1024x1536, exactly the 4 governed King cards at 512x768, matching the script's EXPECTED_LOW_RES_KINGS set
No path traversal / unsafe archive paths in any of the 7 parts
not_verified: That the original single-file archive (matching source_archive.sha256 above) ever produced exactly these bytes - this is the sender's self-reported parts_manifest.json claim, not independently proven
Product-owner attestation (V2-D001) and generation-session evidence (V2-D002) - unchanged, still open
